title: 健康执行器仍然下载失败
premise: 队列已保存并暂停派发，十二个失败运行没有部署回执。
listeningTask: 辨别执行器健康证据与尚未排除的配置问题。

lines.en: Runner health looks normal across pools. CPU and disk have enough room.
lines.zh: 各池执行器健康看起来正常。CPU和磁盘都有余量。

lines.en: Okay, queued builds remain held safely. What's the ETA for a control?
lines.zh: 好，排队构建继续安全挂起。对照测试预计多久？

lines.en: Use one isolated runner for comparison. Match its image and network policy.
lines.zh: 用一台隔离执行器做对照。镜像和网络策略保持一致。

lines.en: Same commit on both runners, right? Otherwise we'd change two variables together.
lines.zh: 两台用同一提交，对吧？不然一次改了两个变量。

lines.en: Use approved short-lived test credentials there. Don't copy production secrets into diagnostics.
lines.zh: 那里用批准的短期测试凭据。别把生产秘密复制进诊断。

lines.en: Both runners fail the same fetch. Managed configuration matches the approved image.
lines.zh: 两台都在同一下载处失败。受管配置与批准镜像相符。

lines.en: That weakens a single-host failure theory. It doesn't clear shared image configuration.
lines.zh: 这削弱了单机故障假设，但没有排除共享镜像配置。

lines.en: Just to confirm, don't recycle pools. We can't rule that out completely.
lines.zh: 确认一下，不重建执行器池。还不能完全排除它。

lines.en: The fetch error names an endpoint. Compare that with the approved source.
lines.zh: 下载错误指出一个端点。拿它和批准的源对比。

lines.en: Actually, that endpoint looks rather old. Let's check dependency settings next.
lines.zh: 其实那个端点看起来挺旧。接下来查依赖设置吧。
